title: Linear space constructibility
statement: The function $S(n)=n+1$ is space constructible: for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1\le n+1$. Moreover, there are a positive integer $c$ and a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet that, on every Boolean input $x$, outputs the binary digit list of $|x|+1$ and uses at most $c(|x|+1)$ work-tape cells.
